title: 第三章 梅丽莎（第一更求推荐票）
content_zh:
确定了计划，周明瑞顿时有了主心骨，惶恐、徘徊和不安全部被蜷缩于了角落。
直到这个时候，他才有心情仔细审视克莱恩残留的记忆碎片。
周明瑞习惯性站起身，关上管道阀门，看着壁灯缓缓黯淡，直至熄灭，自己则重新坐下，一边无意识摩挲着手枪的黄铜转轮，一边按住头侧，于染着绯红色泽的黑暗里静静“回味”，如同电影院里最专心的观众。
或许受子弹穿过的影响，克莱恩的记忆就像摔碎的玻璃，不仅失去了连贯性，很多地方还明显缺失内容，比如做工精致的转轮手枪从哪里来，是自杀还是他杀，笔记本上那句“所有人都会死，包括我”究竟是什么意思，事发前两天有没有参与奇怪的事情。
不仅这些具体的回忆成为了碎片，有所残缺，就连掌握的知识也是如此，以目前的状态看，周明瑞相信克莱恩如果再回到大学，恐怕毕不了业了，哪怕他实际才离开校园几天，并且对自身没有丝毫放松。
“两天后，要参加廷根大学历史系的面试……”
“鲁恩王国的大学有毕业生不直接留校的传统……导师给了一份廷根大学，一份贝克兰德大学的推荐信……”
周明瑞无声“观看”之中，窗外红月西斜，逐渐下沉，直至东方有微光亮起，地平线染上金色。
这个时候，里面房间有动静传出，很快，脚步声靠向隔离门。
“梅丽莎醒了……她还真是一如既往的准时啊。”周明瑞微微一笑，受克莱恩记忆的影响，对梅丽莎有种看自己亲妹妹的感觉。
然而，我并没有亲妹妹……他随即吐槽了一句。
梅丽莎和班森、克莱恩不一样，启蒙教育不是在黑夜女神教会的周日学校完成的，她到读书年纪的时候，鲁恩王国颁布了《初等教育法》，建立中低等教育委员会，并专门提供拨款，加大了投入。
不过三年，在收编了不少教会学校的前提下，众多的公立初等学校建立了起来，严格保持宗教中立性原则，不牵涉风暴之主、黑夜女神和蒸汽与机械之神教会的纷争。
与一周只用一个铜便士的周日学校比，公立初等学校每周三个便士的学费显得颇为昂贵，但前者每周只在周日学习一天，后者一周却要足足上课六天，综合来看，低价至近乎免费。
梅丽莎与大部分女孩不同，从小喜欢齿轮、发条、轴承等事物，立志要做一名蒸汽机械师。
本身吃过文化亏，明白教育重要性的长兄班森就像支持克莱恩读大学一样，支持了妹妹的梦想，毕竟廷根技术学校只能算中等教育，不需要再上文法学校或公学做积累。
去年七月份，十五岁的梅丽莎通过入学考试，如愿以偿成为廷根技术学校蒸汽与机械系的一员，每周的学费也提高到了九便士。
而与此同时，班森供职的进出口公司受南大陆局势的影响，无论利润，还是业务量，都大幅度缩水，不得不裁员超过三分之一，班森为了保住工作，维持生活，只能接受更加繁重的任务，必须经常加班，或是前往环境恶劣的地方出差，就像这几天一样。
克莱恩不是没想过帮哥哥负担，但平民出生的他，普通文法学校考入的他，一进大学，便强烈感受到了自身的不足，比如作为北大陆所有国家源头语言的古弗萨克文，对贵族子弟，对有钱阶层的孩子们来说，那是从小就得学习的内容，而他直到大学，才初次接触。
类似的方面还有很多很多，克莱恩几乎用尽了所有力量，经常熬夜早起，才勉强追上别人，以中等成绩顺利毕业。

关于兄长和妹妹的记忆跳跃于周明瑞的脑海，直及把手转动，里面房间的门吱呀
这可是半管制的物品！
会吓坏小孩子的！
还有，还有我头上的伤口！
眼见梅丽莎即将出来，周明瑞边按住太阳穴，边慌忙拉开书桌抽屉，将左轮手枪丢了进去，砸出砰的一声。
“发生了什么？”梅丽莎听到动静，疑惑地望了过来。
她正值最青春的阶段，即使吃不上什么好东西，脸庞消瘦，略显苍白，皮肤也依旧充满光泽，散发出少女的气息。
看见妹妹褐色的眼眸探究望来，周明瑞强做镇定，将靠近手边的事物拿起，然后从容关上抽屉，掩盖住左轮手枪的存在，而另一只手在太阳穴位置的触感让他确定伤口已经愈合！
他从抽屉里拿出的是一块银白色有藤蔓枝叶花纹的怀表，顶端轻轻一按，表盖便弹了开来。
它是三兄妹的父亲，那位皇家陆军上士遗留的最值钱物品，但二手货毕竟是二手货，最近几年时不时就要出问题，哪怕找钟表工匠修理过，也是一样，这让喜欢带上它抬高身份的班森屡次出糗，干脆丢在了家里。
不得不说，梅丽莎或许真有机械方面的天赋，掌握理论知识后，便开始借助技术学校的工具捣鼓这块怀表，最近更是宣称将它修好了！
周明瑞看着表盖弹开，看到秒针停顿不动，下意识转动顶端，打算给怀表上弦。
然而，他扭了几圈，还是没有发条绷紧的声音传出，秒针依旧一动不动。
“好像又坏了。”他没话找话说地看向妹妹。
梅丽莎没有表情地瞥了他一眼，快步过来，一把拿走了怀表。
她站在原地，先将怀表顶端的按钮拔起，仅仅转动了几圈，便有哒哒哒的秒针走动声传出。
正常来说，拔起不应该是调整时间吗……周明瑞的表情顿时变得呆滞。
就在这个时候，远处大教堂的钟声当当传来，连续六下，悠远而空灵。
梅丽莎侧耳听完，又将怀表顶端的按钮拔高了一截，接着连续扭动，对好了时间。
“好了。”她简短不带一点情绪地说道，然后按回顶端，将怀表还给了周明瑞。

周明瑞尴尬而不失礼貌地回以微笑。
梅丽莎又深深看了哥哥一眼，转身走向橱柜位置，拿上牙刷毛巾等物，拉门而出，前往公用盥洗室。
“她刚才的表情怎么有种嫌弃又无奈的味道。”
“关爱智障哥哥的眼神？”
周明瑞摇头低笑，啪嗒一声合拢表盖，又啪的一声按开。
重复着这样的动作，他思维发散地想到了一个问题。
没有消音器的情况下，克莱恩自杀，嗯，暂时算自杀吧，他自杀的动静绝对不小，一墙之隔的梅丽莎竟然毫无察觉。
是她睡得太熟？还是克莱恩自杀这件事情本身就充满了诡异？
啪，怀表盖子的无意识动作。
她的目光又一次掺上无奈，嗓音甜美地说道：
“克莱恩，你把剩下的面包都拿出来，今天记得买新的，还有肉和豌豆，你快参加面试了，我给你做豌豆炖羔羊肉。”
说话间，她将炉子从角落搬出，借着余炭生火，煮了一壶热水。
水快开之前，她那是真正的茶水。
一人倒了两大杯，梅丽莎和周明瑞就着茶水，分享了两条黑麦面包。
没有混杂木屑，没有太多麸质，然而还是不好吃……周明瑞现在身体虚弱，肚子饥饿，依靠茶水，边腹诽边强行将面包吞咽完毕。
过了几分钟，梅丽莎吃完，拢了拢垂到背心的黑发，看向周明瑞道：
“记得买新的面包，只要八磅，天气热，太多容易坏掉，还有羔羊肉和豌豆，记得！”
果然是关爱书呆子哥哥吗，还要强调一遍……周明瑞微笑点头：
“好的。”
关于鲁恩王国的一磅，周明瑞根据克莱恩的肉测记忆和自己的对比，认为它接近本身习惯的一斤，也就是0.5千克。

梅丽莎没再多说，起身收拾了一下，装好最后那条面包做午餐，戴上母亲遗留的破旧纱帽，拿起自己缝制的装书本文具用提包，准备出门。
今天不是周日，她得上整整一天课。
从这座公寓到廷根技术学校步行需要五十分钟左右，有公共马车，一公里一便士，城内最高限额4便士，城郊6便士，梅丽莎为了省钱，都是提前出门，自己走过去。
“克莱恩，羔羊肉和豌豆不要买多了，班森或许得周日才能回来，嗯，记得面包只要八磅。”
“好，好的。”周明瑞无奈回答。
与此同时，他心里默念了“周日”这个单词几遍。
在北大陆，一年同样分成十二个月，每年三百六十五天到三百六十六天不等，一周同样有七天。
前面是天文学的成果，让周明瑞怀疑这里是平行世界，后者则来源于宗教，因为北大陆正统的神灵共有七位：永恒烈阳、风暴之主、知识与智慧之神、黑夜女神、大地母神、战神、蒸汽与机械之神。
目送妹妹关门离开，周明瑞忽地叹了口气，很快将心思移到了转运仪式之上。
抱歉，我真地想回家……
PS：周一求推荐票~
content_en:
After confirming the plan, Zhou Mingrui suddenly had a backbone, and the fear, hesitation and insecurity were huddled in a corner.
Only then did he have the mood to carefully examine Klein's remaining memory fragments.
Zhou Mingrui stood up habitually, closed the pipe valve, and watched the wall lamp dim slowly until it went out. Then he sat down again, unconsciously rubbing the brass wheel of the pistol while holding the side of his head, quietly "reminiscing" in the crimson darkness, like the most attentive audience in the cinema.
Perhaps due to the impact of the bullet, Klein's memory is like broken glass. Not only has it lost coherence, but there is also a clear lack of content in many places, such as where the exquisitely crafted revolver came from, whether it was suicide or homicide, what the phrase "everyone will die, including me" in the notebook means, and whether he was involved in any strange things two days before the incident.
Not only were these specific memories fragmented and incomplete, but so was the knowledge he mastered. Judging from the current situation, Zhou Mingrui believed that if Klein returned to college, he might not be able to graduate, even if he had only left campus for a few days and had not relaxed at all about himself.
"Two days later, I have to attend an interview at the History Department of Tingen University..."
"The universities in the Loen Kingdom have a tradition that graduates do not stay in school directly... The tutor gave a letter of recommendation from Tingen University and Backlund University..."
While Zhou Mingrui was "watching" silently, the red moon outside the window was slanting to the west, gradually sinking, until there was a faint light in the east and the horizon was dyed golden.
At this time, there was movement in the room inside, and soon, footsteps approached the isolation door.
"Melissa is awake...she is really on time as always." Zhou Mingrui smiled slightly. Affected by Klein's memory, he felt towards Melissa as if he were his own sister.
However, I don't have a biological sister... He complained immediately.
Unlike Benson and Klein, Melissa's enlightenment education was not completed in the Sunday school of the Church of the Night Goddess. When she reached the reading age, the Kingdom of Loen promulgated the "Elementary Education Law", established the Lower and Secondary Education Committee, and provided special allocations to increase investment.
In just three years, many public elementary schools were established on the premise of incorporating many church schools. They strictly maintained the principle of religious neutrality and did not involve themselves in the disputes between the Lord of Storms, the Goddess of Night, and the Church of the God of Steam and Machinery.
Compared with Sunday school, which only costs one copper penny a week, the tuition fee of three pence per week in public elementary schools seems quite expensive. However, the former only has one day of study on Sunday, while the latter has to attend classes for six full days a week. Taken together, the price is so low that it is almost free.
Melissa is different from most girls. She has loved gears, springs, bearings and other things since she was a child, and determined to be a steam mechanic.
The eldest brother Benson, who had suffered a cultural disadvantage himself and understood the importance of education, supported his younger sister's dream just like he supported Klein's college education. After all, Tingen Technical School could only be considered a secondary education, and there was no need to go to a grammar school or public school for accumulation.
In July last year, fifteen-year-old Melissa passed the entrance examination and became a member of the steam and mechanical department of Tingen Technical School. The weekly tuition fee was also increased to nine pence.
At the same time, the import and export company that Benson worked for was affected by the situation in the Southern Continent. Both profits and business volume have shrunk significantly, and they had to lay off more than one-third of their employees. In order to keep his job and maintain his life, Benson can only accept more arduous tasks. He must often work overtime or go on business trips to places with harsh environments, just like the past few days.
It’s not that Klein has never thought about helping his brother to bear the burden, but he was born as a commoner and was admitted to an ordinary grammar school. As soon as he entered university, he strongly felt his own shortcomings. For example, the ancient Fussac script, which is the source language of all countries in the northern continent, is so difficult for the children of the aristocracy and the children of the wealthy class.It was something he had to learn since he was a child, but he didn't come into contact with it for the first time until college.
There are many, many similar aspects. Klein used up almost all his strength, often staying up late and getting up early, just to barely catch up with others and successfully graduate with average grades.
Memories about his brother and sister jumped in Zhou Mingrui's mind, until the handle was turned and the door to the room inside creaked.
这可是半管制的物品！
It will scare children!
还有，还有我头上的伤口！
Seeing that Melissa was about to come out, Zhou Mingrui pressed his temples, hurriedly opened the desk drawer, threw the revolver in, and made a bang.
"What happened?" Melissa heard the movement and looked over in confusion.
She was in her most youthful stage. Even though she couldn't eat anything good and her face was thin and slightly pale, her skin was still full of luster and she exuded a girlish aura.
Seeing his sister's brown eyes looking inquisitively, Zhou Mingrui forced himself to calm down, picked up the thing close to his hand, and then calmly closed the drawer to cover up the existence of the revolver. The touch of his other hand on his temple made him sure that the wound had healed!
What he took out from the drawer was a silver-white pocket watch with a vine pattern. He pressed the top lightly and the watch cover popped open.
It was the most valuable item left behind by the Royal Army Sergeant, the father of the three siblings. But second-hand goods are second-hand goods after all. In recent years, problems have occurred from time to time, even if they were repaired by a watchmaker. This made Benson, who liked to wear it to enhance his status, repeatedly embarrassed himself and simply left it at home.
It has to be said that Melissa may really have a talent for mechanics. After mastering the theoretical knowledge, she began to use the tools of the technical school to tinker with this pocket watch, and recently she even claimed to have repaired it!
Zhou Mingrui watched the watch cover pop open, saw the second hand stopped, and subconsciously turned the top, intending to wind the pocket watch.
However, he twisted it several times, but there was still no sound of the spring tightening, and the second hand remained motionless.
"It seems to be broken again." He looked at his sister with nothing to say.
Melissa glanced at him expressionlessly, walked over quickly, and took away the pocket watch.
She stood there and pulled up the button on the top of the pocket watch. After only a few turns, the second hand clicked.
Normally, shouldn't pulling out be the time to adjust... Zhou Mingrui's expression suddenly became dull.
At this moment, the bells of the cathedral in the distance were heard, six times in a row, distant and ethereal.
After Melissa listened attentively, she raised the button on the top of the pocket watch, then twisted it continuously to set the time.
"Okay." She said briefly without any emotion, then pressed the top button back and returned the pocket watch to Zhou Mingrui.
周明瑞尴尬而不失礼貌地回以微笑。
Melissa took another deep look at her brother, turned around and walked to the cupboard, grabbed her toothbrush, towel and other items, opened the door and went to the public bathroom.
"Why did her expression just now smell of disgust and helplessness?"
“关爱智障哥哥的眼神？”
Zhou Mingrui shook his head and smiled, then closed the watch cover with a snap and then opened it with a snap.
Repeating such actions, he thought of a question in a divergent manner.
Without a silencer, Klein committed suicide. Well, let's call it suicide for the time being. The noise of his suicide was definitely not small, and Melissa, who was separated by a wall, didn't even notice it.
Was she sleeping too soundly? Or is Klein's suicide itself full of weirdness?
啪，怀表盖子的无意识动作。
Her eyes were once again filled with helplessness, and she said in a sweet voice:
"Klein, take out the rest of the bread. Remember to buy new ones today, as well as meat and peas. You are about to go to the interview, and I will make you peas and lamb stew."
While she was talking, she moved the stove out of the corner, used the remaining charcoal to light a fire, and boiled a pot of hot water.
水快开之前，她那是真正的茶水。
oneTwo large cups were poured, and Melissa and Zhou Mingrui drank tea and shared two loaves of rye bread.
There are no sawdust mixed in, not too much gluten, but it still doesn't taste good... Zhou Mingrui is now weak and hungry. He relies on tea and swallows the bread forcefully while cursing.
After a few minutes, Melissa finished eating, smoothed her black hair that hung down to her vest, looked at Zhou Mingrui and said:
"Remember to buy new bread. It only costs eight pounds. It's hot and too much will spoil easily. There's also lamb and peas. Remember!"
Do you really care about your nerdy brother? I have to emphasize it again... Zhou Mingrui smiled and nodded:
"Okay."
As for the pound in Loen Kingdom, Zhou Mingrui compared Klein's meat test memory with his own and believed that it was close to the pound he was used to, which was 0.5 kilograms.
Melissa didn't say anything more, got up and packed up, packed the last loaf of bread for lunch, put on the shabby gauze hat left by her mother, picked up the handbag she made for holding books and stationery, and prepared to go out.
Today is not Sunday, she has to attend class all day.
It takes about fifty minutes to walk from this apartment to Tingen Technical School. There is a public carriage, which costs one penny per kilometer. The maximum limit is 4 pence in the city and 6 pence in the suburbs. In order to save money, Melissa always leaves early and walks there by herself.
"Kline, don't buy too much lamb and peas. Benson may not be back until Sunday. Well, remember that bread only costs eight pounds."
"Okay, okay." Zhou Mingrui replied helplessly.
At the same time, he silently recited the word "Sunday" several times in his mind.
In the Northern Continent, the year is also divided into twelve months, ranging from 365 to 366 days per year, and the week also has seven days.
The former is the result of astronomy, which makes Zhou Mingrui suspect that this is a parallel world, while the latter comes from religion, because there are seven orthodox gods in the northern continent: Eternal Sun, Lord of Storms, God of Knowledge and Wisdom, Goddess of Night, Mother Earth, God of War, and God of Steam and Machinery.
Watching his sister close the door and leave, Zhou Mingrui suddenly sighed and quickly turned his mind to the transfer ceremony.
Sorry, I really want to go home...
